title: On the Maximal Size of Irredundant Generating Sets in Lie Groups and Algebraic Groups
summary: We show the following dichotomy for a connected Lie group $G$: If $G$ is amenable, then any topologically generating set $X\subset G$ of size larger than a fixed polynomial in the dimension of $G$ must be redundant (i.e., a proper subset of $X$ still generates $G$). If $G$ is non-amenable, then it admits arbitrarily large topologically generating sets that are irredundant, and remain irredundant even after applying Nielsen transformations.
